_thread.start_joinable_thread.nython: absent: Nython's threading starts threads as 3.12's (_thread.start_new_thread)

cpython.PyInterpreterState_Clear.nython: absent: C API only (one interpreter per process)

cpython.PyInterpreterState_New.nython: absent: C API only (one interpreter per process)

cpython._PySys_ClearAuditHooks.nython: absent: only C-level hooks (PySys_AddAuditHook) hear it

cpython.run_startup.nython: absent: no PYTHONSTARTUP file at Nython's prompt

ctypes.call_function.nython: absent: raised by CPython's private _ctypes.call_function only

ctypes.dlsym/handle.nython: absent: raised by CPython's private _ctypes.dlsym only

ctypes.seh_exception.nython: absent: Windows SEH (ctypes structured exceptions) not provided

ctypes.set_exception.nython: absent: Windows SEH (ctypes structured exceptions) not provided

nntplib.connect.nython: absent: no nntplib (removed from CPython in 3.13)

nntplib.putline.nython: absent: no nntplib (removed from CPython in 3.13)

os.chflags.nython: absent: BSD/macOS only (no chflags on Linux or Windows)

os.spawn.nython: absent: Windows only (POSIX's os.spawn* are fork + exec: os.fork, os.exec)

sys.set_asyncgen_hooks_finalizer.nython: absent: never raised under this name (Nython raises sys.set_asyncgen_hook_finalizer, as CPython)
sys.set_asyncgen_hooks_finalizer.note: the documented name: CPython raises sys.set_asyncgen_hook_finalizer

sys.set_asyncgen_hooks_firstiter.nython: absent: never raised under this name (Nython raises sys.set_asyncgen_hook_firstiter, as CPython)
